description:
You are an inventory quality manager at a medical supply distribution company. A purchase order has been created for three medical diagnostic products from Medline Industries Inc., but the products are currently configured without lot tracking — a compliance violation. Before validating the receipt, you must enable lot tracking on all three products. Then validate the purchase order receipt, assigning the manufacturer-provided lot numbers to each product:

- LOT-TRACK-001 (Abbott FreeStyle Lite Test Strips 50ct): receive 200 units, lot number MED-2024-AB-001
- LOT-TRACK-002 (Braun ThermoScan Lens Filters LF40): receive 150 units, lot number MED-2024-BR-001
- LOT-TRACK-003 (3M Nexcare Waterproof Bandages 30ct): receive 300 units, lot number MED-2024-3M-001

Login: admin / admin at http://localhost:8069
